newsitem.title: USA: Darden unit to get new look, lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Darden unit to get new look, lower prices.

text.p: Red Lobster, a subsidiary of Darden Restaurants Inc, said on Tuesday that it is dropping prices, adding new entrees and increasing its portions.

The chain of more than 600 restaurants is also commiting $150 million to redecorate and more than 75 percent of its restaurants will have a "new wharfside look" within the next year, the company said.

Fifteen of Red Lobster entrees will now be priced under $10, the company said. The new items were launched on Monday and include blackened catfish fillet with bay shrimp sauce, "Jay's Jump'n Jambalaya," "Almond Crusted Trout," "Mussels Marinara" and "Volcano Shrimp."

The company said it introduced the changes by towing a 50 foot inflatable lobster through the Hudson River along Manhattan. Darden Restaurants closed at 8 3/8 Monday, just above its 52-week low of 7 1/2.
